entries.en: (of flowers or leaves) to wither and drop off; to fade and fall
entries.notes: L 栏「laga」当为「la hoja」之讹；H「凋謝」与 M tiāu-siâ 互证。

entries.en: to fall down; to trip and fall
entries.notes: H 栏「跂/跤」系形近讹字，M tio̍h-poa̍h（著跋，跌倒）可证其义。

entries.en: to fall down (from above, toward the speaker)
to drop (something); to lose by dropping
entries.notes: H 栏「膠流」当为「交落（ka-la̍uh，掉落）」的音写；L 尾「oper derse」读作「o perderse」。

entries.zh: 花（牡丹）从枝上坠落；落花
entries.en: blossoms falling to the ground; flowers dropping from the branch
entries.notes: H 栏「壯丹」为「牡丹」之讹；L 栏严重讹写（「sfuegos deluras aheres」），据「caer…flores」与 M 音定此义。

entries.en: to drool; to slaver; to have the mouth water

entries.zh: 流涎不止（承上条；原稿三栏互不合，义存疑）
entries.en: to be unable to stop dribbling saliva (uncertain; the columns disagree)
entries.notes: H「症痺」与 M siām-bui-tām、R iēn-tān 三者互不合，疑为风病口涎之症，语义难定。

entries.en: to drop and lose; to lose (something) by letting it fall
entries.notes: L「noparecer」读作「no parecer」（落下而不见）；H「打失落」与 M phah-sit-lo̍h 互证。

entries.en: to trip and fall; to stumble
to trip over one's own feet; to stumble
to collapse, to fall in (of a wall); to throw down
to topple down; to let fall, to drop down
to fall outward; to topple outward
entries.notes: H 栏「献出」与「向外倒」义不相合，疑原稿以音近字形记录，义难定。

entries.en: to fall inward; to topple inward
entries.notes: H 栏「献入」与「向内倒」义不相合，疑原稿以音近字形记录，义难定。

entries.zh: 被挤倒（人群推挤而倒，如在斗牛场上）
entries.en: to be knocked over in a crush, as in the bullfight crowd
entries.notes: L 栏末标 [残]、H 栏「桝/挤」存疑；主句「caer de apretados」与 M kheh-tó 可互证。

entries.zh: 横冲直撞；跌撞乱闯（如醉汉）
entries.en: to blunder and bump about; to stagger about like a drunkard
entries.notes: L「caerse en el borracho」疑为「como un borracho」之讹；H「横行直撞」义为乱闯。

entries.zh: 醒悟；明白过来；回心转意
entries.en: to realize; to catch on; to come to one's senses
entries.notes: 「囬」为「回」之异体，四栏实互证（回心／hoê-sim／caer en la cuenta＝醒悟）。

entries.en: to fall backward; to topple over flat
entries.notes: L 栏「Imodoro ŷ luchan」讹写难解，释义依 H「偃倒」与 M ién-tó。

entries.en: to fall into a trap; to be ensnared
entries.notes: L 尾 [残]（「enmon de justi」疑为「en manos de justicia」）；主句「caer en la trampa」与 H「落人圈套」合。

entries.zh: 有的脸朝下、有的脸朝上地仆倒（原稿残损，释义存疑）
entries.en: to fall, some face down and some face up (text corrupt; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: L 栏严重讹写，H「插信」与 M sap-pūn-tùn 义不可解，仅存「boca abajo／boca arriba」可据。

entries.en: to doze off; to fall asleep (while sitting)
entries.notes: H 栏「生」为「坐」形近之讹，M tsē-bîn（坐眠）可证。
